overlay place

  • CURIE: gmeow:overlayPlace
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayPlace
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

The place over which this regulatory overlay applies. Functional: an overlay concerns exactly one place (constitutive of the situation's identity). The place carries the geographic geometry; the overlay carries the regulation and temporal scope.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay -> gmeow:Place; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:overlayPlace from gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay to gmeow:Place when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay, gmeow:Place
